title: Universal Link Crawler, Route Completeness & Zero-404 Navigation Freeze (Deep Link Crawl, Sub-Route Mounting & Header Dropdown Fixes)
spec:
# DIR-025: Universal Link Crawler, Route Completeness & Zero-404 Navigation Freeze

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives
Users and automated testers navigating the platform have reported broken links across core surfaces. A prominent example is the Google M3 Header User Menu (`src/components/cuba/M3UserMenu.jsx`), which points "Your profile" to `/dashboard/profile` and "Security & MFA" to `/dashboard/security`. Neither of these paths is mounted in `DashboardMain.jsx`, resulting in a blank viewport or unhandled route fallthrough.

This directive mandates a comprehensive **Universal Link & Route Audit** across the entire platform. Cline will crawl all internal navigation targets, mount missing route handlers and redirects in `DashboardMain.jsx`, verify all dropdown menu targets in `M3UserMenu.jsx` and `CubaCandidateShell.jsx`, author an automated crawler (`.bridge/evidence/link-crawl-audit.mjs`), and seal the system with a dedicated Playwright E2E suite (`playwright.dir025.config.js`).

## 2. Key Architecture Directives
1. **Mount Missing Sub-Routes in `DashboardMain.jsx`**:
   - Add explicit routes under `/dashboard/*`:
     - `<Route path="profile" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard/settings?tab=profile" replace />} />`
     - `<Route path="security" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard/settings?tab=security" replace />} />`
     - `<Route path="account" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard/settings" replace />} />`
     - `<Route path="billing" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard/plans" replace />} />`
     - `<Route path="my-resumes" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />} />`
     - `<Route path="cv" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard/cover-letters" replace />} />`

2. **Harmonize `M3UserMenu.jsx` & `CubaCandidateShell.jsx`**:
   - Ensure `user?.profileHref` and `user?.securityHref` are consistently wired across Candidate, Recruiter, Enterprise, and Admin contexts.
   - For Candidate: `profileHref: '/dashboard/settings?tab=profile'`, `securityHref: '/dashboard/settings?tab=security'`.
   - For Enterprise: `profileHref: '/org/:slug/settings'`, `securityHref: '/org/:slug/security'`.
   - For Admin: `profileHref: '/admin/settings'`, `securityHref: '/admin/security'`.

3. **Automated Link Crawler (`link-crawl-audit.mjs`)**:
   - Author a Playwright crawler that authenticates and visits:
     - Candidate Dashboard, Header User Menu, Command Palette, Sidebar Navigation.
     - Recruiter Portal, Header User Menu, Navigation Tabs.
     - Enterprise Console, Header User Menu, 12 Console Tabs.
     - Admin System Console, Settings Tree, Navigation Links.
     - Public Marketing Homepage, Footer Links, Secondary Pages.
   - For every link discovered, assert:
     - `page.goto(url)` does NOT produce 404 or maintenance error.
     - `main#main-content` contains rendered child elements (not an empty DOM container).
     - No uncaught JavaScript runtime errors or console error exceptions.

4. **Dedicated Playwright E2E Verification**:
   - Author `playwright.dir025.config.js` targeting `tests/e2e/dir025-link-crawler.spec.js`.
   - Physically click through the header avatar dropdown, verifying that clicking "Your profile", "Settings", and "Security & MFA" navigates cleanly to the intended live views.
invariants: INV-1: Frozen Baseline Integrity: git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js must remain STRICTLY 0 bytes (57 CV templates + AI runtime frozen).
INV-2: Zero Broken Links: Every internal URL rendered in navigation, header dropdowns, command palette, and footers must resolve to a functional, mounted route without blank viewports or 404 errors.
INV-3: Session Guard Consistency: Authenticated routes must strictly redirect unauthenticated guests to /login?next=... rather than displaying broken partial states.
INV-4: Canonical URL Alignment: Use standard Cuba paths rather than fragmenting into conflicting route duplicates; use redirects to guide users to canonical views.
INV-5: Performance Budget: Sub-100ms route transition latency; production bundle build duration < 4.0s.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Comprehensive Real-DOM Link Crawler: Author .bridge/evidence/link-crawl-audit.mjs using Playwright to extract and validate every link (a[href], Link[to], button[data-nav], dropdown menu item) across Candidate, Recruiter, Enterprise, Admin, and Public pages, verifying 100% of internal links resolve to mounted routes.

AC-2: Fix /dashboard/profile & /dashboard/security: In src/components/Dashboard/DashboardMain/DashboardMain.jsx, mount explicit Route handlers for 'profile' (routing to candidate profile or redirecting to /dashboard/settings?tab=profile) and 'security' (redirecting to /dashboard/settings?tab=security) so M3UserMenu 'Your profile' and 'Security & MFA' items load instantly.

AC-3: Cross-Portal Alias & Legacy Redirect Coverage: Audit all candidate sub-routes in DashboardMain.jsx and main.jsx, providing graceful redirects for common variations: /dashboard/account -> /dashboard/settings, /dashboard/my-resumes -> /dashboard, /dashboard/cv -> /dashboard/cover-letters, /dashboard/billing -> /dashboard/plans.

AC-4: Header & Dropdown Integrity Verification: In M3UserMenu.jsx and CubaCandidateShell.jsx, verify that all profileHref, settingsHref, and securityHref props resolve to verified routes across all 4 portal roles (Candidate, Recruiter, Enterprise, Admin).

AC-5: Automated Zero-Broken-Links Census: Output .bridge/evidence/UNIVERSAL_LINK_CENSUS.json cataloging every audited link target, caller component, resolved status code, and confirming 0 broken links / 0 unmounted paths.

AC-6: Dedicated Playwright E2E Suite (playwright.dir025.config.js & tests/e2e/dir025-link-crawler.spec.js): 100% passing tests against live dev server physically clicking all header dropdown items, sidebar nav items, and footer links, verifying zero blank fallbacks and zero 404s.
AC-7: Quality Gates Pass: vite build < 4.0s, eslint 0 errors, npm test zero regressions.

plan.summary: Root cause: the existing 42/42 census is INVALID. link-crawl-audit.mjs walks a HARDCODED path list while SIGNED OUT, so every protected route lands on /login?next=... and is scored PASS off the login page text; the discoveredLinks set it populates is never visited. Fixes: (1) AC-4 role-aware account links via new pure src/components/cuba/accountLinks.js - candidate /dashboard/settings?tab=profile|security, recruiter /employer/settings (no /employer/security is mounted, using it would break INV-2), enterprise orgPathFor settings|security with the server slug, admin /admin/settings and /admin/security; CubaPortalShell gains an explicit portal prop and stops defaulting every portal to /dashboard/*. (2) AC-1 rewrite the crawler as an AUTHENTICATED real-DOM audit using a genuinely minted firebase-admin session, physically clicking the account-menu items (they are buttons with no href, so DOM link extraction cannot see them), then visiting every internal link. (3) Re-derive INV-1 from a real git diff and prove INV-3 guest redirect instead of hardcoding them. (4) AC-6 rewrite the Playwright suite: fix the main-content strict-mode violation, click every dropdown item and sidebar entry. (5) AC-7 build, eslint and npm test gates.
steps: 1. Root-cause the invalid census and capture the signed-out baseline
2. Add pure accountLinks module and wire all four portal shells to role-correct hrefs
3. Rewrite link-crawl-audit.mjs as an authenticated real-DOM crawler that clicks account-menu items
4. Rewrite the dir025 Playwright suite with real dropdown and sidebar clicking
5. Run build, eslint and npm test gates and regenerate the census

reviews.feedback: Lead Architect Review: Plan APPROVED. Execution of role-scoped accountLinks table, real-DOM authenticated crawler, and Playwright E2E suite authorized. Proceed to evidence submission.
